content.title: Savannah Bananas | San Diego Padres
content.text: Go bananas! Back by popular demand, the Savannah Bananas are returning to Petco Park March 21 and 22, 2026.The Banana Ball Ticket Lottery is closed, but there are still Premium Tickets available for purchase. Please email Events@padres.com to learn more.Show times for the Loco Beach Coconuts vs. Savannah Bananas have officially been announced! Get ready for a fun-filled day at Petco Park featuring player appearances, the Before the Peel Show, and more.Saturday, March 21 Gallagher Square Opens: 2 PM All Gates Open: 4:30 PM Show Time: 6:30 PM Sunday, March 22 Gallagher Square Opens: 10 AM All Gates Open: 12:30 PM Show Time: 2:30 PM Get ready for the return of Banana Ball at Petco Park!VIP BANANA TOURSGuests can add on to their Banana Ball experience with a newly announced VIP Tour. This pregame experience gives guests insider access into areas of the stadium normally reserved for players, as well as offers a unique look at the fun, energy, and magic that makes every Savannah Bananas game unforgettable. The tour ends with the viral Petco Park banana pudding and first access to merchandise!VIP Banana Tours are available for each game and a separate ticket is required. Guests must have both a Savannah Bananas game ticket for the same date and a VIP Banana Tour ticket to enter the tour.BANANA BALLBased in Savannah, GA, the Savannah Bananas are a professional baseball team and play their home games at Historic Grayson Stadium, but they are taking the show on the road!What is Banana Ball? Banana Ball is a fast-paced, action-packed style of baseball with rules that include no bunting, a two-hour time limit, fans catching foul balls for outs, batters stealing first base, and a one-on-one tiebreaker showdown at the end of the game if the game is tied.Want to learn more about Banana Ball? Check out Banana Ball rules here and brush up on the history of the game.Savannah Bananas Know Before You GoWe look forward to seeing you at Petco Park for the Loco Beach Coconuts vs. Savannah Bananas on March 21 and 22! Guests are encouraged to arrive early. Re-entry is not permitted. For an enjoyable event experience, please read the following important information before your arrival.ENTRY TIMES AND POLICIES Pre-Game Plaza in Gallagher Square gates open at 2 PM on Saturday and 10 AM on Sunday. Entry gates include: Gaslamp Gate located at the intersection of K Street and 7th Avenue. East Village Gate located at the intersection of K Street and 10th Avenue. Balboa Gate located at the intersection of J Street and 9th Avenue. All remaining gates will open at 4:30 PM on Saturday and 12:30 PM on Sunday. No re-entry will be allowed. Factory-sealed plastic bottled water that is still, clear, and unflavored and is one (1) liter or less are permitted into Petco Park. In addition, one (1) liter reusable water bottles (no glass) are permitted and must be empty upon entry into the ballpark. No other outside food or beverage is permitted. For enhanced ballpark security and to expedite the entry process for all our guests, Petco Park prohibits bags with the exception for single compartment clear plastic bags not exceeding 12" X 6" X 12" and infant and medical bags. Clutches and purses no larger than 5" X 7".. Click here for more information on Petco Park's prohibited items. Petco Park offers Lock & Go Lockers for a flat $14 rate. There are (4) four Lock & Go Lockers located around Petco Park - Balboa Gate, East Village Gate Box Office, Lexus Premier Lot, and at the intersection of Tony Gwynn Dr. and L Street. Guests will need to pick up their belongings no later than 30 minutes after the end of the game. DIGITAL TICKETINGSeating Bowl, Suite, & Hospitality Spaces: Tickets purchased through the Padres Season Ticket Member presale, or tickets for a suite or hospitality space will be accessible via the MLB Ballpark app. View our digital ticketing guide for information on how to access and transfer tickets. In advance of the game, be sure to transfer tickets to everyone in your party so each individual has access to their own ticket.Savannah Banana Lottery Ticket Holders: Your digital tickets on the Banana Ball ticket platform, FansFirst, will be available for downloading to your mobile wallet 72 hours before the first pitch. For the fastest, smoothest entry, please add all tickets to your digital wallet. Log into your ticket account here. For more information or to view steps on how to download tickets to your digital wallet, visit the Banana Ball Ticket FAQ.Please note: If you pre-purchased parking, your parking pass will be delivered digitally to your MLB Ballpark app.GETTING TO PETCO PARKWe are expecting a sold-out crowd for this show and strongly recommend ticket holders arrive early, as well as take advantage of public transportation or rideshare options. Padres parking lots will open at Noon (12 PM) on Saturday and 8 AM on Sunday for pre-purchased passes in the Lexus Premier Lot, Padres Parkade, and Tailgate Lot. Day-of parking will be limited and subject to availability. Purchase pre-paid Padres parking below. If you pre-purchase parking, your parking pass will be delivered digitally to your MLB Ballpark app.Please note: Tailgating is not permitted in the Tailgate Lot for this event.Looking for parking in additional lots in downtown San Diego? Reserve a space on SpotHero, the proud parking partner of the San Diego Padres.For guests using rideshare, a designated rideshare loading zone is located across the street from the Bayfront Hilton Hotel (next to the Convention Center) on Harbor Drive and Park Boulevard. We encourage guests to get dropped off and picked up at this location and then take the pedestrian sky bridge towards Petco Park.Explore the MTS Trolley and take the easy way to get to the show! For more information, including the Trolley and Coaster schedule, click here.TRAFFIC WARNING FOR SATURDAY 3/21Please note the intersection at 16th St. and Imperial Ave. will be closed on Saturday 3/21 to all traffic from 6 AM - 6 PM and could cause delays arriving to the event.MERCHANDISE There will be an early merchandise opportunity on Friday, March 20 from 2–5 PM on the exterior of the East Village Gate. On event days, Banana Ball merchandise tents will be located both outside and inside the ballpark. Merchandise stands located on J Street will open at 11 AM on Saturday and 10 AM on Sunday. Petco Park is a cashless venue. SAVANNAH BANANAS SPECIALTY ITEMSEntrées & Shareables Havana Banana Pork Sandwich: Roasted plantains, mojo pork, smoked ham, crispy onions, Swiss cheese and jalapeño aioli served on a potato roll. Available at: Seaside Market (Section 105) Plantain Nachos: Crispy plantain chips served with peach salsa, perfect for sharing. Available at: Seaside Market (Section 105) and Section 100 (F/G) portable Banana Pizza: Grilled peach, stracciatella, prosciutto, pistachio, hot honey, arugula and Aleppo pepper. Available at: Gelati and Peccati (Section 102) Desserts Loconut Donuts: Mini Donut Company donuts finished with pineapple icing and toasted coconut. Available at: Mini Donut (Section 107) Banana Pudding: Fresh bananas, hazelnut crumbles and whipped cream. Available at: Seaside Market (Section 105) Banana Lumpia: Filled with chocolate, hazelnut and marzipan butter, finished with horchata whipped crème. Available at: Tony Gwynn Terrace Ballpark Eats (Gallagher Square) and Seaside Market (Section 105) Specialty Beverages Carajillo (Banana Twist): A Spanish and Latin American coffee cocktail with a banana‑inspired twist. Available at: Karl Strauss, Pacifico, and Swinging Friar bars in Sections 110, 121, 122, 320, and Gallagher Square. Banana Mudslide: Cutwater Banana Mudslide cocktail. Available at: Karl Strauss, Pacifico, and Swinging Friar bars in Sections 110, 121, 122, 320, and Gallagher Square. Non‑Alcoholic Offerings Loco Coco Lemonade: A tropical blend of coconut and lemonade. Available at: VW Bus and all Pizza Port locations. PLAZA IN GALLAGHER SQUAREThe Pre-Game Plaza in Gallagher Square offers an unforgettable experience filled with energy, excitement, and entertainment for fans of all ages. From live performances, special appearances from players, cast, mascots, and other surprise guests, it’s a must-see event. There will also be merchandise tents in the pre-game plaza. Fans must have ticket to the game to access the Plaza, no additional purchase required.
